fix/restack-skip-dirty-current-worktree.description: restack skips (under sync) or refuses cleanly when the current worktree has uncommitted changes, instead of aborting the whole run on git's rebase precondition

context.text: Pre-check the current worktree with git's own rebase precondition (staged or unstaged changes to tracked files) before the first in-place rebase, and treat it like a dirty worktree elsewhere: skip under sync's skip-blocked policy, fail cleanly otherwise. Untracked files don't block, because git rebases over them.
